title: Patch: practice deals one daily All Random setup for everyone
thread:
**Issue #2882 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2882: Patch: practice deals one daily All Random setup for everyone
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Practice games against the computer each start from a fresh random shuffle. After this change the practice menu also offers "today's deal": one fixed shuffle per day that every player gets, so friends can compare how they did with the same cards, and a shared replay file proves what happened.

## Why

- The design pillars are seeded randomness, chaos and short sharp games (`spec/01-overview.md` §1): a date-derived seed is the cheapest possible shared ritual, and the deck streams already exist (`{seed}:human-deck`, `{seed}:ai-deck` in `crates/server/src/economy/practice.rs`'s header; R433 dealt decks).
- It needs no server, no account and no leaderboard: the client deals from the date seed under the current catalog, and the existing replay download (R1141000, `apps/web/src/replay/download.ts`) is already the verifiable, name-free way to share a result.
- This is new: rejected #1998 (hand-built one-turn puzzles) and #1193 (trap minimums in dealt decks) are different ideas, and no open issue covers a shared daily setup.

## Proposal

- Add a "Today's deal" entry to the practice setup (`apps/web/src/practice/PracticeSetup.tsx`) that starts an All Random game from a `daily-<date>` seed with the player's usual difficulty and lean choices; the seed rolls over at UTC midnight.
- Reuse the practice worker path (`core.ts`) unchanged, including earning claims (the seed is a normal practice seed) and the catalog-version check on saves.
- Document it as a practice setup option in the spec's practice section (§9.9), not as a mode: queue, ranked and records are untouched.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/practice/` (`PracticeSetup.tsx`, `core.ts`, `protocol.ts`); `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.9 (one paragraph); no engine, server or catalog change.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Two devices starting today's deal get identical human and AI decks and identical AI behavior.
- [ ] Yesterday's deal is still replayable from its seed; today's changes at UTC midnight.
- [ ] A finished daily game claims earning exactly like a normal practice game, and its downloaded replay opens in the replay player.
- [ ] A catalog patch does not silently re-deal mid-day games under new cards (the save/version rule decides, and says so).

## Size and risks

Small-medium: web client plus a spec paragraph; likely `difficulty:medium`. Risk is players gaming a known deal for earning; the daily Jlore cap (R1483000) already bounds that, and the claim still folds the full log.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.
```
